subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Focus Indicators and Visibility
description: A 60-second lesson on Focus Indicators and Visibility.

hook.text: A keyboard user tabs through a page. There is no visible focus indicator. They have no idea where they are.

buildup.text: Focus indicators show which element is currently active when navigating with a keyboard or assistive device.

discovery.text: WCAG 2.2 requires focus indicators with a minimum area and contrast ratio to ensure clear visibility.

twist.text: Many sites remove default focus outlines for aesthetics. This makes keyboard navigation impossible.

climax.text: Custom focus styles that are both visible and attractive replace the removed defaults. Navigation is restored.

punchline.text: Never hide focus. Style it to be visible and beautiful.

quiz.question: Why do some sites break keyboard navigation?
options: They remove default focus outlines for visual aesthetics
